One question I had is how would end users elect who to be these judges? I mean in the real world we are battling 10-30% of voter turnout and that is with TV and radio ads, etc. Also the elections actually impact the laws being passed.

Another question is what criteria would we be basing these elections on? What prevents this from being a high school election where the most popular poster gets elected. Should the MrBabyMan, or Unidan's of the world be running the site?

I believe if in the real world, we could vote for president on the internet, the turnout would be higher. I know how stupid that may sound but the convenience of clicking a button at home would made a difference, I believe. I know we can't vote for president online, but we can vote here. This would be something admins would have to help us with.

The criteria would also be something we'd have to discuss. I'm proposing a tiered moderation system. I have a lot of ideas but not all the answers, and I'd just like to have other people on board so we can all put our ideas on the table and figure things out. Surely if I or anyone did this or anything similar alone it would fail. We need a few good minds to solve these problems.

Surely we don't want corrupt or plain shitty mods running the site, but that's why this would be tiered with each level checking the next. The upper most level would be most important to assure that someone of value is put into, and these positions would probably have the highest prerequisites. In a sense PART of it will be popularity (just like any election for anything ever), but the idea is that the popular candidates would be popular because of their leadership and ideas. But you can't stop a shitty guy from voting for a shitty guy, and that's part of life, and in a democracy you have to leave the possibility open that the most popular guy may not be the guy you want.
